reviews.text: Was there on Saturday with my dog and I want to thank the entire staff for their hospitality and knowledge . They have affordable packages and they are inside of Petco which makes traveling with my fur baby fun because we got to shop for treats and toys after his visit. Thanks
Our first visit with my cat Grumpers and we couldn’t be happier. From beginning to end everyone was outstanding . Very happy to have found this clinic.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

The doctors simply did not seem to care about my precious girl Star who is a Tux Cat, and the entire experience made me feel like the staff hated their jobs. My cat needed X-rays, and from the moment we arrived, I felt like her care was not being taken seriously.

The communication was also extremely difficult. The nurse who was assisting me did not speak English well, so throughout the entire appointment, she was trying to communicate with me through Google Translate. I understand that language barriers happen, but it made an already stressful situation even harder because I was trying my best to explain my cat’s symptoms and what was going on with her.

I was then told that my cat needed X-rays and was given a price. When I asked questions because I was trying to understand whether pet insurance or any other options were available to help with the cost, I felt like there was absolutely no willingness to help or explain anything. It essentially felt like, “This is the price pay it or risk whatever is wrong with your pet.” When you are worried about your animal, that is an incredibly frustrating position to be put in.

The doctor was also very rude and barely examined my cat. I left feeling like the entire visit had been a complete waste of my time and money.

I ended up taking my cat to Banfield, and the experience was completely different. They had more affordable options, wellness plan options, treated my cat with care, actually took the time to see her, and she was able to receive her X-rays and additional care.

Unfortunately, I will never bring another animal to Vetco again. When you take your pet to a veterinarian, you should feel like the people caring for them genuinely care about their well-being. I did not feel that way here.

I brought my puppy in on Thursday and it was the best service I have ever gotten at a veterinary clinic. Super friendly and kind staff. They were very attentive to me and my baby and they even played with her for a little bit. Would totally recommend.
Thanks to the Vetco team, they are very kind and attentive to all their animals and their families.
Staff very nice. Moderate price.
Caring staff. Clean office. My furbaby was well taken care of.
This place is amazing!! Great staff and super helpful with everything, Best vet i’ve been too.
Had an amazing visit! My cat and I felt at ease during the whole visit. I appreciate how after my pet saw the doctor I got a breakdown of the prices before services were performed.
Loved the atmosphere staff was very attentive and courteous !!!!
My experience today was beyond perfect. All of the staff made me and my Fur baby feel welcomed. I highly recommend this hospital for everything from vaccines to X-rays. Thanks ♥️
Extremely happy with this clinic. Everyone made us feel welcomed and the prices are reasonable. Glad they are conveniently located inside of Petco.
So glad you guys are up and running again! Thanks for the great service. Staff are helpful and courteous
Visit was smooth , a lot of wrong information . very misleading with prices, Overall I ended up paying 450 for something that was supposed to be less .
Fantastic for vaccines.

Today I received the worst ever customer service In the 25 years that I lived in this country. I feel beyond insulted and humiliated. I made an appointment online 4 days ago for today Saturday August 2, at 5:30 pm. I arrived at 5:25 and to my surprise, I was informed that I had to make the line (8 customers with their pets). I asked myself, so what's the point in getting an appointment. I decided to wait, since my cat needed urgent de-worming treatment. After 2 hours waiting in line, and when there was only 1 customer before me, the assistant informed me that the doctor was leaving and she was not taking any more customers. She offered to reschedule the appointment in 2 weeks and to give me a 20% discount. I begged them to please just apply the de-worming shot to my cat, I can come back some other day for the rest. "The doctor did not accept". That was the answer, no explanation. I am not coming back to this awful place. I took my other cat to the Pet Supermarket walk in clinic last week, three blocks from there, no appointment, no issues, in and out in less than 20 minutes. Please don't let this people ruin your day. They don't deserve our business.

They did a great surgery on my dog but definitely go elsewhere to get vaccines or rabies tags. They charged me $85 for a rabies tag that is $30 through Miami Dade. When I asked the vet tech they said Miami Dade raised its prices just now....however I called the Miami Dade office and that was untrue.  Vaccines are much less expensive elsewhere.  Other than that the office was nice.
Have been taking my dog here since I got him and they offer the best service.

I was very depressed and stressed out because I had no idea what was happening to my cat. I was attended right away! Everyone was very nice and everything was explained thoroughly! Dr. Berry is a sweetheart and while my cat was being treated he noticed I was very anxious and he helped calm me down with conversation. I am extremely happy with the service and will be back 😄
All the service was very good.

Gave it one star because is the only way to write the review, but would have given it none, got there at 6:20 pm and they said they were closed for the day and that they don’t take emergencies. Why would they advertise otherwise? Don’t waste your time, go somewhere else.👎 …

gave absolutely incredible service to my cat smokey, and are the one vet he actually likes going to. staff is exceeding kind and accommodating to your needs, couldnt have asked for a better experience

I wish I could give zero Stars. We had a 5:30 appointment and we reached on time, but the receptionist was no where to be seen, when she came back she said we were too late and cancelled our appointment.
Dr. faria & staff are extremely professional
